title: Cover live cleanup phase, production COMMIT failure and abandoned slowest ticks
outcome: Observer regression coverage protects live cleanup phase transitions, failed production COMMIT metrics and abandoned-scope slowest retention.
acceptance: Deterministic controls cover live commit to commit_cleanup phase ordering and measured sub-metrics on a failed production COMMIT.
An abandoned scope that finishes with default timings is asserted in slowest retention; existing retention, privacy and rollback assertions remain.
Compare helper success/error behavior with pinned rusqlite Transaction::commit where this adds meaningful independent coverage.
